mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished lymph network to the supplied arm was most worthwhile because it brought the separate route back into the larger body model and showed why drainage matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route to the venous junction felt somewhat mechanical: the marked outlet made the choice obvious, though it did complete the path.

surprise.text: The explanation that tissue fluid carries proteins through overlapping flaps, and is then called lymph, made the collection process more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each piece had a visible role in the supply or return route.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: linking fluid drainage to circulation gave a clear reason for building the route, and I would be curious to see another body-system connection. The largely predictable choices were less engaging on their own.
